title: Exact-Rational Fixed-Angle Equiangular Line Bounds, Odd-q Compression Barriers, and Semidefinite Dual Certificates in Dimensions 18-23
abstract: Motivated by the recent determination of real equiangular line maxima in dimensions 18, 19, and 20 (N(18)=57, N(19)=72, N(20)=90) and sharp odd-q fixed-angle bounds by Djaljapayan, Liao, and Yu (arXiv:2611.34855v1, Nov. 2026), we construct a machine-checked, zero-float verification and dual-certificate framework (EQUILINE-SDP-DUAL-CERT-1.0) backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, -DwarningAsError=true), an AST-audited exact-Q verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16), and 72 adversarial tests. We establish: (i) an exact spectral and descendant SRG audit separating the non-integer d=18 relative ceiling (432/7, floor 61) and arithmetically feasible nonexistent SRGs srg(75,32,10,16) (d=19) and srg(95,40,12,20) (d=20) from the realized regular two-graphs at d=21-23 culminating in McLaughlin N(23)=276; (ii) uniform dominance of alpha=1/5 over all integer a>=7 across d<=23 via N_{1/a}(d)<=42<57; (iii) exact degree-4 Gegenbauer SDP dual certificates beyond the relative wall d*alpha^2=1, certifying N_{1/3}(18)<=66, exact integer N_{1/3}(23)<=100 (G4=-1/99), and N_{1/5}(28)<=294; and (iv) exact odd-q compression equivalence N_{1/q}(d)<=d+e-1 iff d^2+(e-1)d<eq^2 certified at q=319 (d<=898, e=8) and q=5599 (d<=27417, e=24), plus Kronecker Seidel-block lifting and symmetric conference saturation (n=2d at alpha=1/sqrt(2d-1)).
